$comment: Published directories that list many GTFS feeds, read by scan-feed-sources.py --source feed-lists. Distinct from watch-pages.json, which watches one page per feed for a URL that moves; these are third-party catalogues where the finding is a feed appearing or disappearing. Carried over from transitland-gtfs-scraper/watch/watch_feed_lists.py, which held these URLs but was never implemented. The cal-itp agencies.yml entry from that list is dropped: airflow/data/ no longer exists in cal-itp/data-infra, and California is covered by --source calitp. Add a source by appending here; the first run records its feeds without reporting a change.

sources.name: MnDOT feed list
sources.note: Cambridge Systematics hub for Minnesota DOT. Identifies feeds by id, not URL, so json-values rather than urls.

sources.name: GMV Syncromatics directory
sources.note: Vendor-published list of every Syncromatics tenant, static and realtime. JSON.

sources.name: Virginia DRPT
sources.note: Treat with suspicion: the domain has shown signs of being re-registered and filled with generated content rather than serving DRPT data. Verify any feed found here against the agency before registering it.

sources.name: 511NY Data Tools
sources.note: Arcadis Data Tools deployment for New York State.

sources.name: MassDOT / MBTA developer list
sources.note: State page listing Massachusetts feeds beyond the MBTA's own.

sources.name: National Park Service
sources.note: CSV backing https://www.nps.gov/subjects/developer/gtfs.htm. The page appends a cache-busting query string; it is dropped here so the URL stays stable.
